title: 边积分最高的节点
summary: 每个节点 i 有一条指向 edges[i] 的边，节点积分为所有指向它的源节点下标之和，返回积分最高且下标最小的节点。
insight: 一次扫描把源下标 i 加到 score[edges[i]]，再按下标升序找严格更高积分即可自然保留最小下标。

solutions.title: 累加入边源下标
solutions.idea: 构造每个目标节点积分后选最大。
steps: answer=0，i 升序比较严格大于当前积分时更新

code.java: class Solution { public int edgeScore(int[] edges){long[] scores=new long[edges.length];for(int i=0;i<edges.length;i++)scores[edges[i]]+=i;int answer=0;for(int i=1;i<edges.length;i++)if(scores[i]>scores[answer])answer=i;return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun edgeScore(edges:IntArray):Int{val scores=LongArray(edges.size);for(i in edges.indices)scores[edges[i]]+=i;var answer=0;for(i in 1 until edges.size)if(scores[i]>scores[answer])answer=i;return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public:int edgeScore(vector<int>& edges){vector<long long> scores(edges.size());for(int i=0;i<(int)edges.size();++i)scores[edges[i]]+=i;int answer=0;for(int i=1;i<(int)edges.size();++i)if(scores[i]>scores[answer])answer=i;return answer;} };
